rows.question: Please generate a summary of the closing balances at the end of each month for each customer transactions, show the monthly changes and monthly cumulative bank account balances. Ensure that even if a customer has no account activity in a given month, the balance for that month is still included in the output.
rows.pred_sql:
WITH customer_monthly_agg AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', txn_date) AS INTEGER) AS year,
    CAST(strftime('%m', txn_date) AS INTEGER) AS month,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN lower(txn_type) = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
        WHEN lower(txn_type) = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount
        ELSE txn_amount
      END
    ) AS monthly_txn_sum
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, year, month
),
customer_month_series_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    MIN(txn_date) AS min_txn_date,
    MAX(txn_date) AS max_txn_date,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', MIN(txn_date)) AS INTEGER) AS start_year,
    CAST(strftime('%m', MIN(txn_date)) AS INTEGER) AS start_month,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', MAX(txn_date)) AS INTEGER) AS end_year,
    CAST(strftime('%m', MAX(txn_date)) AS INTEGER) AS end_month,
    date(substr(MIN(txn_date),1,7) || '-01') AS start_month_date,
    date(substr(MAX(txn_date),1,7) || '-01', '+1 month', '-1 day') AS end_month_date
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
months_per_customer AS (
  -- generate months for each customer between start and end inclusive using a manual sequence
  SELECT
    b_inner.customer_id,
    ((b_inner.start_year * 12 + (b_inner.start_month - 1) + seq.offs) / 12) AS yr,
    ((b_inner.start_month + seq.offs - 1) % 12) + 1 AS mo,
    date(
      printf('%04d-%02d-01',
        ((b_inner.start_year * 12 + (b_inner.start_month - 1) + seq.offs) / 12),
        (((b_inner.start_month + seq.offs - 1) % 12) + 1)
      )
    ) AS month_start_date,
    date(
      printf('%04d-%02d-01',
        ((b_inner.start_year * 12 + (b_inner.start_month - 1) + seq.offs) / 12),
        (((b_inner.start_month + seq.offs - 1) % 12) + 1)
      ),
      '+1 month', '-1 day'
    ) AS month_end_date
  FROM customer_month_series_bounds b_inner,
  (
    SELECT 0 AS offs UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL
    SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL
    SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL
    SELECT 15 UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 UNION ALL
    SELECT 20 UNION ALL SELECT 21 UNION ALL SELECT 22 UNION ALL SELECT 23 UNION ALL SELECT 24 UNION ALL
    SELECT 25 UNION ALL SELECT 26 UNION ALL SELECT 27 UNION ALL SELECT 28 UNION ALL SELECT 29 UNION ALL
    SELECT 30 UNION ALL SELECT 31 UNION ALL SELECT 32 UNION ALL SELECT 33 UNION ALL SELECT 34 UNION ALL
    SELECT 35 UNION ALL SELECT 36 UNION ALL SELECT 37 UNION ALL SELECT 38 UNION ALL SELECT 39 UNION ALL
    SELECT 40 UNION ALL SELECT 41 UNION ALL SELECT 42 UNION ALL SELECT 43 UNION ALL SELECT 44 UNION ALL
    SELECT 45 UNION ALL SELECT 46 UNION ALL SELECT 47 UNION ALL SELECT 48 UNION ALL SELECT 49 UNION ALL
    SELECT 50
  ) seq
  WHERE
    (b_inner.start_year * 12 + (b_inner.start_month - 1) + seq.offs)
    <= (b_inner.end_year * 12 + (b_inner.end_month - 1))
)
SELECT
  m.customer_id,
  m.yr AS year,
  m.mo AS month,
  m.month_start_date,
  m.month_end_date,
  COALESCE(a.monthly_txn_sum, 0) AS monthly_change,
  -- closing_balance = cumulative sum of monthly_change up to this month for this customer
  COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT SUM(COALESCE(a2.monthly_txn_sum, 0))
      FROM months_per_customer m2
      LEFT JOIN customer_monthly_agg a2
        ON a2.customer_id = m2.customer_id AND a2.year = m2.yr AND a2.month = m2.mo
      WHERE m2.customer_id = m.customer_id
        AND (m2.yr < m.yr OR (m2.yr = m.yr AND m2.mo <= m.mo))
    ),
    0
  ) AS closing_balance,
  -- cumulative_balance is same as closing_balance here
  COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT SUM(COALESCE(a2.monthly_txn_sum, 0))
      FROM months_per_customer m2
      LEFT JOIN customer_monthly_agg a2
        ON a2.customer_id = m2.customer_id AND a2.year = m2.yr AND a2.month = m2.mo
      WHERE m2.customer_id = m.customer_id
        AND (m2.yr < m.yr OR (m2.yr = m.yr AND m2.mo <= m.mo))
    ),
    0
  ) AS cumulative_balance
FROM months_per_customer m
LEFT JOIN customer_monthly_agg a
  ON a.customer_id = m.customer_id AND a.year = m.yr AND a.month = m.mo
ORDER BY m.customer_id, m.yr, m.mo

rows.question: For each customer and each month of 2020, first calculate the month-end balance by adding all deposit amounts and subtracting all withdrawal amounts that occurred during that specific month. Then determine which month in 2020 has the highest count of customers with a positive month-end balance and which month has the lowest count. For each of these two months, compute the average month-end balance across all customers and provide the difference between these two averages
rows.pred_sql:
WITH months AS (
  SELECT 1 AS month UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL
  SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL
  SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12
),
customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions
),
-- compute month-end balance for each customer for each month in 2020 (deposits minus withdrawals within that month)
customer_month_population AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    2020 AS year,
    m.month AS month,
    COALESCE(s.month_end_balance, 0) AS month_end_balance
  FROM customers c
  CROSS JOIN months m
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      customer_id,
      CAST(strftime('%Y', txn_date) AS INTEGER) AS year,
      CAST(strftime('%m', txn_date) AS INTEGER) AS month,
      SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END)
        - SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) AS month_end_balance
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', txn_date) AS INTEGER) = 2020
    GROUP BY customer_id, year, month
  ) s
  ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id AND s.year = 2020 AND s.month = m.month
),
month_stats AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    month,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN month_end_balance > 0 THEN 1 END) AS positive_count,
    AVG(month_end_balance) AS avg_balance
  FROM customer_month_population
  WHERE year = 2020
  GROUP BY year, month
)
SELECT
  printf('%04d-%02d', hm.year, hm.month) AS highest_month,
  hm.positive_count AS highest_month_positive_customer_count,
  hm.avg_balance AS highest_month_avg_month_end_balance,
  printf('%04d-%02d', lm.year, lm.month) AS lowest_month,
  lm.positive_count AS lowest_month_positive_customer_count,
  lm.avg_balance AS lowest_month_avg_month_end_balance,
  (hm.avg_balance - lm.avg_balance) AS difference_in_averages
FROM
  (SELECT year, month, positive_count, avg_balance
   FROM month_stats
   ORDER BY positive_count DESC, year, month
   LIMIT 1) hm
CROSS JOIN
  (SELECT year, month, positive_count, avg_balance
   FROM month_stats
   ORDER BY positive_count ASC, year, month
   LIMIT 1) lm
